info.title: TFB Supplier Portal — API
info.description:
API consumed by the **TFB Supplier Portal** (`samsam2703MFC/supplier_atl`), served by the **TF Buddy** backend.

All endpoints are relative to `‹host›/api/v1`. The portal resolves the host from the `API_BASE_URL` environment variable (default: the TF Buddy test environment).

## Authentication

`POST /material-suppliers/auth/login` with the supplier's **external user** credentials returns an `access_token` (HS512 JWT, 30 min) and a `refresh_token`. Every other call sends `Authorization: Bearer ‹access_token›`; when the access token nears expiry the portal transparently calls `/material-suppliers/auth/refresh`. An `Accept-Language` header selects the response language. Supplier login accounts are managed by an administrator (`/material-suppliers/{id}/external-user`).

## Portal routes

The portal itself is a server-rendered PHP app mounted at `‹host›/supplier`. Its pages (`/auth`, `/dashboard`, `/analytics`, `/catalog`, `/raw-materials`, `/recipes`, `/price-list`, `/orders`, `/logistics`, `/complaints`, `/clients`, `/me`, `/logout`) each consume the endpoints below server-side; the page-local `/ajax/*` routes proxy the same endpoints for in-page actions. The full route list lives in `src/core/Bootstrap/Routes/`.
